headline: Congress renamed the Postal Service facility at 108 West Maple Street in Holly, Michigan, the Holly Veterans Memorial Post Office.
what_it_does: This law gives a specific Postal Service building in Holly, Michigan a new official name, the Holly Veterans Memorial Post Office. It does not change how mail is handled, what services the office offers, or who runs it. It is a naming measure only.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2020, and the renaming took effect on that date.
